session.title: Hotel California solo practice
session.goal: Play the opening phrase cleanly at 80 BPM

summary.headline: Your phrasing is recognizable. Prioritize the bend at 0:18 and the rushed transition at 0:41.

events.observation: The whole-step bend stops about a quarter-tone flat.
events.evidence: Audio pitch contour and visible bend travel agree.
events.action: Pre-bend to the target note, check it against the fretted pitch, then release slowly.

events.observation: The position shift lands roughly 90 ms early and compresses the next two notes.
events.evidence: Onset timing moves ahead of the 80 BPM grid during the shift.
events.action: Loop beats 2–4 at 65 BPM and keep the picking hand moving through the shift.

events.observation: The fretting wrist bends inward during the reach, adding tension.
events.evidence: Wrist angle increases while the thumb rises over the neck.
events.action: Move the thumb toward the center of the neck and bring the guitar neck slightly higher.

practice_plan.title: Bend calibration
practice_plan.instructions: Alternate the target fretted note with a silent pre-bend, five clean repetitions per set.

practice_plan.title: Position-shift loop
practice_plan.instructions: Loop 0:37–0:45 at 65 BPM. Increase by 3 BPM after three clean repetitions.

practice_plan.title: Relaxed reach
practice_plan.instructions: Practice the reach without picking while keeping the wrist neutral and thumb centered.
